Make check-and-reserve atomic versus every generic/context/native start/toggle/cancel; return busy with no queue through startup/listening/drain. Keep stop/status/quit usable; termination tombstones the token before late arm. Use fake phases/clock/worker barriers; don't expose an incomplete native route.

tasks.title: Deliver accepted finals once and drain safely
tasks.description: Add native recovery ledger, FIFO offers and verified ACKs, then connect identity-gated recorder events and terminal lifecycle to the bounded owner transport.

subtasks.title: Retain bounded native recovery in memory
subtasks.context_scope:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: architecture/system_context.md identifies SessionRecovery._fit_text and legacy draft's cap-at-close, wrong for native.
2. INPUT: UUID/sequence schema from P1.M1.T3.S2; accepted final IDs/text, offer-attempt and verified-ACK signals.
3. LOGIC: Add separate proposed NativeRecovery leaf in session_recovery.py: 1 MiB UTF-8 per active or ended session including separators; retain unacknowledged accepted finals only, mark possible prior insertion before attempt, remove verified ACKs, retain up to two nonempty ended IDs. Bound memory/state, preserve truncation/uncertainty metadata, handle Unicode safely, clear at exit, isolate legacy SessionRecovery. Pure fixtures/fake clock; no I/O.
4. OUTPUT: Retain/mark-attempt/settle/end/read/clear interface plus recovery snapshots for P1.M1.T4.S2, P1.M1.T4.S6 and P1.M1.T5.S1.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Add native-vs-ordinary retention/ownership/uncertainty docstrings in session_recovery.py.

subtasks.title: Enforce one sequenced offer and verified ACK
subtasks.context_scope:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: architecture/system_context.md defines a small leaf queue and separate recovery ledger; retain-before-offer matters on failure.
2. INPUT: PRD v1 ACK/offer validators from P1.M1.T3.S2 and recovery operations from P1.M1.T4.S1.
3. LOGIC: Build editor_session.py FIFO policy: eight total including outstanding, each <=4 KiB UTF-8, monotonic sequence, one offer outstanding, 5 s ACK deadline, attempt recorded before write. Only exact matching ACK settles; exact duplicate last ACK harmless (no extension/replay), malformed/stale/uncertain delivery revokes. Overflow retains for recovery and signals revoke/drain, never truncate an insert. Mock clock and write result; no socket wait in state transitions.
4. OUTPUT: enqueue/offer/ack/deadline/revoke operations consumed by P1.M1.T4.S4, P1.M1.T4.S5 and P1.M1.T4.S7.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Document queue/attempt semantics and deadline ownership in editor_session.py.

Use fake child queues and race gates; no media/model devices.

Native partials may support lifecycle only; no generic injection, recovery, transcript feedback/latency/log or evdev guard (including arm/run/reader paths). Preserve media/mic lifecycle. subtasks.title: Stop, cancel and drain one native utterance
subtasks.context_scope:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: architecture/system_context.md maps _request_stop, _maybe_auto_stop, run/host.text, _begin_drain and _safe_abort; generic graceful_stop cannot dictate native semantics.

Loss/EOF revoke first, then at most current utterance to recovery only; Cancel revokes and aborts, no new capture. No abort/drain waits under daemon lock or on recorder reader. Fake ASR, cancellation/barrier events, media and monotonic clock.
4. OUTPUT: Bounded Stop/Cancel/loss/idle lifecycle with one terminal action for P1.M1.T4.S6 and P1.M1.T4.S7.

Expose stable transcript-free reason/recovery hint in status/logs and neutral optional warning if editor UI is gone. Keep normal status safe and stop/quit responsive through all phases. Fake dead child, shutdown and idle watchdog races, feedback with content tripwires.

subtasks.title: Establish mounted wrapper and stock runtime compatibility

3. LOGIC: Establish wrapper under integrations/pi with one base in the actual mounted factory; preserve default/previous factory behavior and hooked callbacks. Bounded isolated PTY smoke upstream and stock non-JIT Bolt for mounting, public socket runtime and an editor-local invocation surface that acts on a nonempty draft without changing it (e.g. public fullscreen mouse controls if qualified). No forced slot takeover, private APIs or JIT as substitute. Mock socket peer and extension/provider services; document a blocker if no compatible public path.
4. OUTPUT: Verified wrapper/runtime and invocation seams for P1.M2.T1.S2, P1.M2.T1.S3 and P1.M2.T1.S5.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Start integrations/pi/README.md compatibility/prerequisite section with verified facts/limits only; document mounted wrapper API.

subtasks.title: Connect the Pi client to the native session
subtasks.context_scope:

2. INPUT: Shared wire vectors from P1.M1.T3.S2, endpoint from P1.M1.T4.S7 and validated runtime seam from P1.M2.T1.S1.
3. LOGIC: Implement independent TS client (qualified built-in Unix socket runtime) for private XDG, v1 Start/events, bounds, ping, deadlines, stop/cancel, and ACK hook available only to a verified edit. On malformed/unexpected frame, late task/EOF or write ambiguity revoke locally, no fallback/reconnect/replay. Use fake server/clock with shared vectors and no clipboard/audio/desktop.
4. OUTPUT: Local session client and loss/offer callbacks for P1.M2.T1.S3 through P1.M2.T1.S5.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] integrations/pi/README.md and client API docs describe daemon/protocol and runtime prerequisites and no automatic fallback.

subtasks.title: Pin the live Pi target and revoke before mutation
subtasks.context_scope:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: architecture/editor_apis.md records UTF-16 getCursor/getLines, marker ambiguity, callback rewiring and app.editor.external keybinding matcher.
2. INPUT: Mounted wrapper from P1.M2.T1.S1 and local revocation from P1.M2.T1.S2.
3. LOGIC: Snapshot actual editor identity, revision, caret and supported mode at Start; take newest eligible pre-caret UTF-8 suffix <=4 KiB or empty with send_context=false. Invalidate before input/edit-and-return/caret/paste/submit, remapped external action, replacement or session shutdown; preserve delegation and own-mutation distinction. Refuse ambiguous markers/unsupported modes. Mock mounted editor, matcher and socket; prove remap revokes before external invocation.
4. OUTPUT: Sticky checkpoint/guard and seed from live buffer for P1.M2.T1.S4 and P1.M2.T1.S5.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] integrations/pi/README.md describes eligibility, context opt-out and target-loss triggers; add checkpoint contract docstrings.

subtasks.title: Splice and verify one undoable Pi final
subtasks.context_scope:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: architecture/editor_apis.md and plan 008 pi_seam_proof.md pin one native insert, UTF-16 columns, undo snapshot, normalization and requestRender.
2. INPUT: Shared padding vectors from P1.M1.T3.S2, offer/ACK from P1.M2.T1.S2 and pinned checkpoint from P1.M2.T1.S3.
3. LOGIC: In the same UI turn recheck checkpoint, compute §C padding from adjacent Unicode scalars and make one insertTextAtCursor call; verify exact entire text and resulting caret, update checkpoint, then ACK. Refuse unsupported normalization before mutation and revoke on uncertainty, no second attempt, whole-buffer setter, simulated paste or neighbor replacement. Mock wire/edit mutation failures and check Unicode and Undo adjacency with editor fixture.
4. OUTPUT: Verified splice operation for P1.M2.T1.S5 and T10c real-editor qualification.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] integrations/pi/README.md describes undo, uncertainty and no replay; document splice verification interface.

subtasks.title: Expose editor-local Pi actions and opt-in installation
